{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Filter for new customers reached by paid search
filtered_df = sales_df[
    (sales_df['channel'] == 'paid_search') & 
    (sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'new')
]

# Compute the fraction who converted
n_total = len(filtered_df)
n_converted = filtered_df['converted'].sum()
fraction_converted = n_converted / n_total

# Print results
print(f"Total new customers reached by paid search: {n_total}")
print(f"Number who converted: {n_converted}")
print(f"Fraction converted: {fraction_converted}")"}
